name: CUE PITY'S ARROW
source:
[i]Another day, another date.
Will this finally be [b]the one[/b]?[/i]

[b]Karius Myn[/b] is not one unfamiliar to the dating scene — in fact, he is [i]deeply[/i] immersed in it.

He has every app, heeds every call of companionship, and flourishes in exchanging pleasantries with those most pleasant.

However, with his [b]luck[/b], this never results in any kind of long-lasting connection.

But that's all fine, right? He'll find [i][b]the one[/b][/i] eventually.

At a strange café in downtown Eirimerry – the [b]mage[/b] capital of the world – he arranges to meet up with a peculiar girl...

[From [url=https://jimothie.itch.io/cupity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]另一天，另一次约会。
这最终会是[b]那个[/b]？[/i]

[b]卡里乌斯·敏[/b]人们对约会场景并不陌生——事实上，他是[i]深[/i]沉浸其中。

他拥有各种应用程序，留意每一次陪伴的呼唤，并且热衷于与最令人愉快的人寒暄。

然而，凭借他的[b]运气[/b]，这永远不会导致任何形式的持久连接。

但那都很好，对吧？他会发现[i][b]那个[/b][/i]最终。

在埃里梅里市中心一家奇怪的咖啡馆里——[b]法师[/b]世界之都——他安排会见一个奇特的女孩……

[来自[url=https://jimothie.itch.io/cupity]痒痒io[/url]]
